rtmp_url.description: Prepared RTMPS ingest URL for recovering an active YouTube Live API runtime. Stream key material must remain in stream_key_secret_name.

stream_key_secret_name.description: Short-lived runtime secret reference for YouTube Live API stream key. The raw key must not be included in this object.

complete_on_stop.description: When true, Control Panel completes the YouTube Live broadcast during normal stream stop. Manual retry and cleanup may force completion.

complete_retry_count.description: Number of failed YouTube Live API complete attempts retained for automatic backoff retry.

complete_next_retry_at.description: Next automatic YouTube Live API complete retry time, when a retained runtime is waiting for retry.

complete_last_error.description: Safe error code from the latest YouTube Live API complete failure. Raw OAuth or stream key material must not be included.
